conditionalVersionAudit: condDistrib is an upstream selected regular conditional kernel, not a new literal project-defined conditional law. T4 identifies it only history-law-a.e. Uniqueness is modulo that relation, not pointwise. Histories vary by t; no single exception subset of all history carriers is claimed. For a fixed nu, pullbacks of the countably many exceptional history sets can be united into a null set on the game space; no uniform null set for every nu follows.

sourceDeltaLedger.detail: All five endpoints are derived infrastructure/application contracts. Neither page prints kernel, uniform representation, recursive sampler or conditional-distribution theorems.
Past-known/current-outcome-hidden information is made exact as dependence on u_0,...,u_t and y_0,...,y_(t-1). Current private uniform is permitted; future uniforms are excluded pointwise.
Action-inclusive finite histories and arbitrary real outcome prefixes are new model choices. Sampler realization applies to all histories, including unreachable histories.

The product law U×nu covers exogenous outcome streams, including dependent/unbounded streams for law clauses. It does not model the full printed p3 action-reactive adversary or prove equivalence to every hidden-state/causal policy model.
Fresh-seed independence, standard-Borel representation and conditional-law disintegration/uniqueness are external derived obligations, not omitted printed theorems or public assumptions of T5.
T5 risk branch retains IID independent coordinates, common marginal and [0,1] outcomes. Support is stated coordinatewise almost surely; countability yields simultaneous support for a fixed nu.
Expected fixed benchmark is inf over c in [0,1] of expected cumulative loss; equality to T variance requires a derived feasibility/optimality bridge. It is not expected empirical hindsight regret.

Zero-based t and every natural horizon T, including zero, extend the positive-round source convention. Eq1.2 division interpretation uses positive T only; no normalized/little-o conclusion is asserted.

No convergence or sublinear-success theorem, executable sampler, uniqueness of the sampler, arbitrary action-space representation, stopping-time theorem, completed-filtration equivalence, chapter/book closure or original-PR disposition follows.

independentStressChecks: At t=0, empty history and A0=f0(empty,u0); no y0 leakage.
At t=1, the history stores A0, not u0; current action may depend on y0 and u1 but not y1.
A constant nonoptimal kernel can have linear expected excess, so nonnegativity is not universal success.
Changing a conditional-law version on an exceptional history does not contradict all-history sampler realization.
Dependent outcomes are allowed in T3/T4, but current-outcome independence needed in T5 risk can fail without IID.
At T=0 all sums and expected fixed benchmark are zero; positive-T division of Eq1.2 is not invoked.
For T5, f depends on kappa but not on outcome law, its analytic mean, or horizon.
